purpose: Behavioral migration map, not a claim of passing results. Run the named suites to verify.
localCallPrerequisite: Iroh relay reachable on 127.0.0.1:7003 and openssl on PATH (or OPENSSL executable path); runner starts TLS proxy on 7004 and isolated Vite on 5187.

scenarios.notes: Restricted duration controls replaced with unlimited history and logout/onboarding checks; signer, registration and QR behavior retained.

Real Iroh transport, decoded audio, video frames, mute, capture errors, redial, screen sharing, detached windows, rooms and relay approval. Requires ANAGRAM_LIVE_CALL_TEST=1 and local Iroh relay on 7003. UI-only tests do not replace these.
Contact restoration, refresh, creation and QR behavior retained; Vue/Quasar header geometry is not an implementation contract.
